title: VUEO 0.9.4
changelog: Final VUEO mobile UI overhaul based on the approved mockups
Approved VUEO logo and wordmark integrated across launcher, splash and app UI
Cinematic Home hero with Watch Now and My List actions
Search redesigned with filters, featured result and poster grid
Library, Settings, Content Manager and Who's Watching visually unified
White remains the default interface accent with five optional accent colors
